name: What should I look for in a seasonal maintenance checklist?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a seasonal maintenance checklist?

acceptedAnswer.text: A comprehensive seasonal maintenance checklist should cover key areas of your home. It should include roof and gutter inspection, checking for leaks and structural integrity. HVAC systems need to be on the list for filter replacement and system checks. Inspect plumbing for drips or blockages. Test all smoke and carbon monoxide detectors. Review the exterior for siding, paint, and foundation issues. Don't forget to include checking windows and doors for drafts or damage, and assessing outdoor areas like decks and railings for safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: A good checklist includes roof and gutter inspection, HVAC checks, plumbing assessment, safety alarm testing, exterior review, and checking windows, doors, and outdoor structures.
